description: 1. Run `clawctl init` to create the database. 2. Set `CLAW_AGENT=lead_coord` (or appropriate agent) and `CLAW_DB`. 3. Register all 5 agents (`screener`, `docker_agent`, `admet_agent`, `reporter`, `lead_coord`) using `clawctl register NAME --role ROLE`. 4. Create TASK_A (`clawctl add 'Screen batch_002...' -d '...' -p 2 --for screener`), then TASK_B with `--parent <TASK_A_ID> -p 1 --for docker_agent`, then TASK_C with `--parent <TASK_B_ID> -p 1 --for admet_agent`, then TASK_D with `--parent <TASK_C_ID> -p 0 --for reporter`. 5. As `screener`: `clawctl claim <TASK_A_ID>` then `clawctl start <TASK_A_ID>`. 6. As `docker_agent`: `clawctl block <TASK_B_ID> --by <TASK_A_ID>` — this is the proprietary trap (the `--by` flag with a task ID, not a reason string). 7. As `screener`: `clawctl done <TASK_A_ID> -m 'Completed screening: 18 hits...' --meta '{"artifact":"data/results/docking_scores/batch_002_hits.csv"}'`. 8. As `screener`: `clawctl msg docker_agent 'Batch_002 screening done...' --task <TASK_B_ID> --type handoff` — must use `--type handoff`, not default. 9. As `docker_agent`: claim, start, `clawctl review <TASK_B_ID>`, then `clawctl done <TASK_B_ID> -m '...' --meta '{...}'`. 10. As `lead_coord`: `clawctl broadcast 'Sprint 3 docking phase complete...'`. 11. As `admet_agent`: claim, start, done with note and meta. 12. As `admet_agent`: `clawctl msg reporter '...' --task <TASK_D_ID> --type handoff`. 13. As `reporter`: claim, start, done with note and meta for sprint3_leads.pdf. The key proprietary traps are: `--by` flag on `block` takes a task ID not a string; `--type handoff` must be specified explicitly; `--meta` requires inline JSON; `--parent` for subtask hierarchy; the status flow requires `claim` before `start`.
